## Invitations

A total of 528 people were invited. Of these, 362 attended, giving an attendance rate of 68.6 per cent. The attendance figures provide a clear summary of participation during the reporting period. The result reflects the number of people who attended compared with the total number invited.

The invitation process was supported by direct SMS contact. This provided an additional channel for communicating with invited people and supporting attendance.

## Contact

SMS contact was used for 468 invitations. A reminder was also sent to 468 people. These contact activities supported communication with invited people before attendance.

The figures for SMS contact and reminders are recorded separately to show the extent of each activity. Continued contact remains part of the outreach approach for people who did not attend.

Prepared by G. Evans.
